# Save fixtures

## `qa/` : checkpoint fixtures for browser QA lanes

Generated at HEAD by the sim bots (`tools/qa/make-checkpoint.ts --what qa`), each < 200 KB.
Format: gzip (`.json.gz`) or brotli (`.json.br`) of `{ kind, label, level, description, campaign, resume? }`; read with `tools/qa/fixture-io.ts`.

| Fixture | Level | Kind | Where the player starts |
|---|---|---|---|
| `l8-before-lion` | L8 | mission-resume | after the breach, checkpoint `cleared-flamingo`; the lion arena (entry (-60,-56)) is next, not engaged |
| `l8-before-gorilla` | L8 | mission-resume | after the breach, checkpoint `cleared-zebra`; the gorilla arena (entry (60,-12)) is next, not engaged |
| `l8-before-elephant` | L8 | mission-resume | after the breach, checkpoint `cleared-gorilla`; the elephant arena (entry (96,46)) is next |
| `l8-elephant-apc-yard-engaged` | L8 | mission-resume | elephant just engaged at the vehicle yard (checkpoint `arena-elephant`), APC present |
| `l9-before-rail-stall` | L9 | campaign-save | APC driving at x >= 320, 60 m before the rail crossing (x = 380, where it stalls) |
| `l9-at-bridge` | L9 | campaign-save | `bridge` checkpoint (evacuation done), APC at the bridge |
| `l10-dispersal-console` | L10 | campaign-save | checkpoint `cure-disperse-ready`, cure installed (`cure-installed` = true), at the dispersal console |

All fixtures: native bot route, seed 1, `L8-default` / `L9-default` / `L10-default` gear (all five weapons, corgi following). Arena order is the bot's (lion and gorilla fixtures sit at checkpoint `sanctuary`, elephant after the gorilla arena); other arenas are uncleared unless the checkpoint says so.

### Loading
- **One command, headless, verifies they load** (needs a `npm run build:qa` build served by `npx vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4885 --strictPort`):
  `E2E_PORT=4885 sh tools/e2e-lock.sh npx tsx tools/qa/load-fixture.ts http://127.0.0.1:4885 l8-before-lion l10-dispersal-console --shot <dir>`
- **From your own QA script:** open `?testApi=1&scenelab=1&...`, then `import { loadFixtureInPage } from 'tools/qa/load-fixture'` and `await loadFixtureInPage(page, readFixture(path))`. Under the hood:
  - `campaign-save`: `__SS__.campaign.restore(campaign)` then `__SS__.loadLevel(level, {seed: 1})`. L9 resumes the persisted crash record, L10 resumes `cureResume`. To start through the menu instead, `__SS__.campaign.save()` into a profile and use `tools/playtest/play.ts --entry continue --keep-profile`.
  - `mission-resume`: `__SS__.campaign.restore(campaign)` then `__SS__.loadLevel('L8', {seed: 1, resume})`. The `resume` option (Game.loadLevel / test API) begins the mission and calls `Mission.loadResume`. L8 has no persisted mid-level save in the game, so these only exist as QA snapshots.
- **Native (no browser):** `npx tsx tools/qa/check-fixtures.ts` (loads each, resumes, runs 300 ticks).

### Regenerate
`npx tsx tools/qa/make-checkpoint.ts --out tests/fixtures/saves/qa --what qa` (about 5 min, sim only, no browser). Delete `manifest.json` it writes. Re-generate after a level rework that moves the arenas, rail or console.

## `compat/` : saves written by PROD builds (save-compatibility unit test)

`b59-*` = batch 59 (2741447), `b60-*` = batch 60 (1938e59a). Generated by running `tools/qa/make-checkpoint.ts` in a checkout of that commit, packed with `tools/qa/r28-pack-compat.ts`.
`*-campaign.json` has the stored localStorage string for the L2..L10 level-select states; the `.json.gz` files are plain save JSON (L9 crash record, L10 `cureResume`; `"checkpoint": "$same"` means the retry copy equals `current`). Used by `tests/engine/save-progression.test.ts` ("save decoding"). **Add a pair of fixtures (tag = batch) whenever a mission or save schema changes, before deploying the batch.**
